exclusions.reason: Internal until Infinitary has its own Google client: a released build offers no Google sign-in until Infinitary registers its client with Google and passes Google's verification and security assessment, so nobody can use Gmail through the app yet; the release that turns it on carries the note.

What a crewmate hears when an MCP server's change it asked for loses its connection after the server took it: it now reads that the outcome is unknown and is never told to make the change again; a person sees no new screen or control.
